name: Reconstruction behavioral fidelity v1
syllabus: Assess observable reconstruction only. Mechanical truth stays separate. A correct native refusal can score highly even if the requested task cannot finish. Missing evidence requires unassessable, not invented credit. Calibration is provisional.
